userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-listof>` element builds a list of reference entries or links to labelled document elements.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| List link | Follow the link to its document element. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Move between generated links. |
| Enter | Follow the focused link. |
| Ctrl+? | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include Shift if needed to type ?. |
